patches.name: Subtitle translation
patches.description: Translates external subtitle files into a language you choose. The on/off switch and the target language live in the kyurem39's patches settings panel.

patches.name: Vietnamese interface
patches.description: Adds a Vietnamese interface that is enabled by default, plus a "kyurem39's patches" settings row that opens the patch settings panel and the About screen.
